decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered 1010 PA05 Rev. A, 1010 PA06 Rev. A, 1010 PA07 Rev. B, and 1010 PA08 Rev. B; Flood Risk Assessment Rev. B: all received 6 August 2010, therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment Rev. B: all received 6 August 2010and the basement shall not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - No demolition or construction work shall commence prior to the submission of and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority, of a Construction Management Statement (CMS) in respect of the proposed basement. The details and measures identified in the statement shall be carried out as approved. The CMS shall be certified by a qualified Engineer and include:(i)	Borehole /soil test results;(ii)	Details of the impact of the development, and associated construction and temporary works, on the structural stability of the existing and adjoining buildings;(iii)	Details of the impact of the development on drainage, sewage, surface water and ground water, flows and levels (and how any geological, hydrological and structural concerns have been satisfactorily addressed;(iv)	The engineering details of the scheme, including methods for excavation and construction;(v)	Details of the impact of the development on any existing trees; and(vi)	Details of the sequence for the temporary works, which mitigates the effects on neighbours
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extensions and the construction of a basement including front and rear lightwells, and a terrace at rear
